review_locator: PMCID:PMC3579502, Transcriptional regulation of follicular T-helper (Tfh) cells; PMCID:PMC4174316, Complex Interactions of Transcription Factors in Mediating Cytokine Biology in T Cells
primary_title: The AP-1 transcription factor Batf controls T(H)17 differentiation
decision_basis: The review identifies BATF binding at the Il17a-Il17f locus and IL-17-associated promoters; the cited primary demonstrates BATF occupancy at Il17 regulatory elements, loss of IL-17 transcriptional output in Batf-deficient Th17 cells and BATF-responsive Il17 promoter activity, supporting a bounded BATF-to-IL17A gene-regulation edge.
limitations_preserved: Direct BATF occupancy and Batf-dependent Il17 regulatory activity support gene activation; the shared Il17a/Il17f locus and cytokine readouts do not justify an independent IL17F edge here, and no protein secretion, IL17R signaling, SCI relevance, or terminal-TF output is inferred.

primary_title: The AP-1 transcription factor Batf controls T(H)17 differentiation
decision_basis: The review identifies BATF binding at the Il22 promoter in Th17 cells; the cited primary reports BATF-associated Il22 promoter/locus occupancy and reduced Il22 expression in Batf-deficient Th17 cells, supporting a bounded BATF-to-IL22 gene-regulation edge.
limitations_preserved: BATF occupancy and Batf-dependent Il22 expression support gene-level regulation; the evidence does not establish IL-22 secretion dynamics, IL22R signaling, SCI relevance, or terminal-TF output.
